content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Jadavpur University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Jadavpur University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Faculty posts at Jadavpur University?
faq.answer: Jadavpur University is recruiting for a total of 3 Guest Faculty posts across different specializations.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The last date for the walk-in interview is 01 September 2026. There is no separate application deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications are as per UGC/State Government rules for all the advertised posts.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty positions will be as per University norms.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Jadavpur University, Kolkata, West Bengal, 700032.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply offline for these posts?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is strictly through a Walk-in Interview. Offline applications are not mentioned.
